'''Converger''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A logistics unit that merges up to 3 transport belts into 1 single belt.|A transport system adjustment unit with a smart sorting module. Can be used in all sorts of production lines.}}
==Usage==
A logistics unit that merges up to 3 transport belts into 1 single belt.

The Converger can converge product flows of 3 transport belts into a single belt.
==Acquisition==
*Requirement : [[AIC Plan#Basic AIC Plan|Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC III - Belt Converging]]
